message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on **June 18, 1815**, resulted in roughly **25,000 casualties** overall—about 25,000 soldiers were killed or wounded across all sides. In more detail:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allied forces (including German contingents) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | ~22,000 |

These figures include those killed, wounded, missing, and captured. The exact numbers vary slightly among sources, but the consensus places total casualties at around 25,000–30,000 men.
